---
title: Email testing built for automation.
description: Create disposable inboxes and receive real application emails directly from your automated tests. One API, no mail server.
---

<Install>
<Tab label="TypeScript">
```bash
npm install @testinbox/client
```
```typescript
import { TestInbox } from "@testinbox/client";

const client = new TestInbox({ apiKey: process.env.TESTINBOX_API_KEY });
const inbox = await client.inboxes.create({ ttl: 3600 });
```
</Tab>
<Tab label="Python">
```bash
pip install testinbox
```
```python
from testinbox import TestInbox

client = TestInbox(api_key=os.environ["TESTINBOX_API_KEY"])
inbox = client.inboxes.create(ttl=3600)
```
</Tab>
<Tab label="cURL">
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.testinbox.email/v1/inboxes -H "X-Api-Key: $TESTINBOX_API_KEY"
```
</Tab>
</Install>

<Steps variant="strip" title="The workflow">
<Step title="Create an inbox">
`inboxes.create()`
</Step>
<Step title="Trigger your app">
`app.signUp(address)`
</Step>
<Step title="Wait for an email">
`messages.wait()`
</Step>
<Step title="Assert its contents">
`expect(message.links[0])`
</Step>
</Steps>
